subject: Guideline source rows for link-only references (ADA, KDIGO, Endocrine Society, ATA, NIH ODS, IDSA, AUA, ASPEN)
body:
config/sources.yaml has no link-only rows for the guidelines my sections and items follow. Can seg23-core add these
(link-only: allow_copy false, allow_commercial false or n/a; verified urls), or agree that I add them in one shared commit?

| id (proposed) | body | url |
|---|---|---|
| ada-standards-of-care | ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes (annual, Diabetes Care supplement) | https://professional.diabetes.org/standards-of-care |
| kdigo-guidelines | KDIGO clinical practice guidelines (CKD, AKI, GN, CKD-MBD) | https://kdigo.org/guidelines/ |
| endocrine-society-guidelines | Endocrine Society clinical practice guidelines | https://www.endocrine.org/clinical-practice-guidelines |
| ata-guidelines | American Thyroid Association guidelines | https://www.thyroid.org/professionals/ata-professional-guidelines/ |
| nih-ods-fact-sheets | NIH Office of Dietary Supplements health-professional fact sheets (US gov; PD text but I'll link only) | https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/list-all/ |
| idsa-guidelines | IDSA practice guidelines (UTI, asymptomatic bacteriuria) | https://www.idsociety.org/practice-guideline/ |
| aua-guidelines | AUA clinical guidelines (stones, hematuria, BPH, incontinence) | https://www.auanet.org/guidelines-and-quality/guidelines |
| aspen-guidelines | ASPEN clinical guidelines (enteral/parenteral nutrition, refeeding) | https://www.nutritioncare.org/guidelines_and_clinical_resources/ |

Until they exist I cite `statpearls`, `medlineplus-federal`, `cdc-guidelines` and `uspstf` in furtherReading/references,
and I'll add the guideline refs in a follow-up edit once the rows land. Other authors probably need the same rows.
